items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: "Remember when we used to play by Miss Bessie?" and "By Miss Bessie we had Kid Sheik back there."

ctx.x: But Sheik was my regular band. Who did you have with that band? I mean, uh, do you remember the men, when Eddie came back? Whenever did get that strike, who would have been in your band when Eddie came back? That's after you came out. Oh, yeah. Well, we was using most of the time, and Howard was in with us. Howard was in with us. Yeah. Howard was in with us. Yeah. So, that'd be Sheik. Eddie Summers, Howard, Thang. Yeah. Yeah. And, uh, who I was talking about. Big was, you, Big Art. Big Art. Big Art. Big Art on…

Yeah. Joe Morris used to play with us too, with Kid Sheik. Yeah. When was that? Early or was that? That was back in 1948, wasn't it? When Joe Morris was playing. Remember when we used to play by Miss Bessie?

About Little Joe? Or Daddy. His daddy. He used to play two ways to move into. Yeah. So, when you made that record, the one down there, you know, that we all made out, Tulane, that was more or less a regular band, I mean, together, you know what I mean? It was, it wasn't just pick up. No, we hadn't been playing together, you know. We had been playing together. We were all we know when it wasn't too much for, when we'd add something.
